name: arsenal_tab
why: Every armament through the arsenal tab, for AD-019 W4 (QA-055). The tab was the one display of the weapon calculation no capture had ever read, and the tiles_and_panel raster does not reach it: it drives the six planner tiles and the breakdown panel, all of which rank at the slot's tier, while the tab ranks at the spinbox's (AD-020, point 1). The slots here are held fixed on Wylder's own starting armament and only the arsenal block sweeps, because the tab does not care which armament sits in a slot -- it ranks every armament in the dataset against the build. Wylder at level 15 because that is the build QA measured QA-018 and QA-055 on. Configuration 1 is QA-055's own case, verbatim: slot on tier 3, spinbox on 1, not a single relic.
